name: ecomm-backend
description: Scalable E-Commerce Platform — modular monolith backend (admin auth foundation)

scripts.dev: node scripts/with-env.mjs --file .env --app-env local -- tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.dev:local: node scripts/with-env.mjs --file .env --app-env local -- tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.dev:production: node scripts/with-env.mjs --file .env.production --app-env production -- tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.build: prisma generate && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-generated.mjs
scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-generated.mjs
scripts.prisma:migrate:local: node scripts/with-env.mjs --file .env --app-env local -- prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:deploy:local: node scripts/with-env.mjs --file .env --app-env local -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prisma:deploy:production: node scripts/with-env.mjs --file .env.production --app-env production -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed:local: node scripts/with-env.mjs --file .env --app-env local -- prisma db seed
scripts.db:seed:production: node scripts/with-env.mjs --file .env.production --app-env production -- prisma db seed
